normal_rare.name: Extreme Speed
normal_rare.desc: Always moves first. The first hit each battle gives your whole team +1 Speed.

normal_legendary.name: Judgment
normal_legendary.desc: Becomes whichever type the target is weakest to. +10 power for every different type on your team.

fire_common.name: Flame Charge
fire_common.desc: +1 Speed to the user on every hit.

fire_rare.name: Heat Wave
fire_rare.desc: Every other enemy takes half damage too. 10% burn.

fire_legendary.name: Sacred Fire
fire_legendary.desc: 50% chance to burn. Always a critical hit against a burned target.

water_common.name: Brine
water_common.desc: Double damage against a target at half HP or less.

water_rare.name: Liquidation
water_rare.desc: Every hit lowers the target’s Def by 1.

water_legendary.name: Water Spout
water_legendary.desc: Power scales with the user’s remaining HP. Every KO heals the user 25% of its max HP.

electric_common.name: Spark
electric_common.desc: 30% chance to paralyse (halves Speed for the fight).

electric_rare.name: Thunderbolt
electric_rare.desc: 20% chance to paralyse. +1 Speed to the user on every hit.

electric_legendary.name: Bolt Strike
electric_legendary.desc: 30% chance to paralyse. Against a paralysed target it always moves first and deals 1.5×.

grass_common.name: Giga Drain
grass_common.desc: Heals the user for half the damage dealt.

grass_rare.name: Petal Blizzard
grass_rare.desc: Every other enemy takes half damage too.

grass_legendary.name: Seed Flare
grass_legendary.desc: Every hit lowers the target’s Sp.Def by 2. Every KO heals your whole team 20% of its max HP.

ice_rare.name: Icicle Crash
ice_rare.desc: 30% chance to flinch. 10% chance to freeze.

ice_legendary.name: Sheer Cold
ice_legendary.desc: A target left below 25% HP is knocked out outright. 20% chance to freeze.

fighting_common.name: Power-Up Punch
fighting_common.desc: +1 Attack to the user on every hit.

fighting_legendary.name: Secret Sword
fighting_legendary.desc: Hits whichever of the target’s defences is weaker. Every KO gives your whole team +1 Attack and +1 Sp.Atk.

poison_common.name: Venoshock
poison_common.desc: Double damage against a poisoned target.

poison_legendary.name: Malignant Chain
poison_legendary.desc: Every hit adds 3 poison stacks to EVERY enemy. Deals 1.5× to poisoned targets.

ground_common.name: Bulldoze
ground_common.desc: Every hit lowers the target’s Speed by 1.

ground_rare.name: Earthquake
ground_rare.desc: Every other enemy takes half damage too.

ground_legendary.name: Precipice Blades
ground_legendary.desc: Hits every enemy for full damage, and every enemy hit loses 1 Speed.

flying_common.name: Acrobatics
flying_common.desc: Double damage while the user holds no item.

flying_rare.name: Brave Bird
flying_rare.desc: The user takes a third of the damage dealt as recoil. +1 Attack on a KO.

flying_legendary.name: Oblivion Wing
flying_legendary.desc: Heals your whole team for half the damage dealt.

psychic_common.name: Stored Power
psychic_common.desc: +20 power for every positive stat stage on the user.

psychic_rare.name: Psychic
psychic_rare.desc: Every hit lowers the target’s Sp.Def by 1.

psychic_legendary.name: Psystrike
psychic_legendary.desc: Hits whichever of the target’s defences is weaker. +20 power for every positive stat stage on the user.

bug_common.name: Fell Stinger
bug_common.desc: +3 Attack to the user on a KO.

bug_rare.name: Lunge
bug_rare.desc: Every hit lowers the target’s Attack and Sp.Atk by 1.

bug_legendary.name: Techno Blast
bug_legendary.desc: Never resisted. +15 power for every Bug-type on your team.

rock_common.name: Rock Tomb
rock_common.desc: Every hit lowers the target’s Speed by 1.

rock_legendary.name: Diamond Storm
rock_legendary.desc: Attacks with the user’s Defense instead of its Attack. +2 Def to the user on every hit.

ghost_common.name: Hex
ghost_common.desc: Double damage against a target with a status condition.

ghost_rare.name: Poltergeist
ghost_rare.desc: Deals 1.5× to a target holding an item.

ghost_legendary.name: Spectral Thief
ghost_legendary.desc: Steals the target’s stat boosts before hitting. +10 power for every positive stat stage on the user.

dragon_rare.name: Dragon Pulse
dragon_rare.desc: The first hit each battle gives your whole team +1 Attack and +1 Sp.Atk.

dragon_legendary.name: Spacial Rend
dragon_legendary.desc: Always a critical hit. Every hit lowers the target’s Def and Sp.Def by 1.

dark_common.name: Knock Off
dark_common.desc: Deals 1.5× to a target holding an item.

dark_rare.name: Foul Play
dark_rare.desc: Attacks with the target’s Attack stat instead of the user’s.

dark_legendary.name: Dark Void
dark_legendary.desc: 30% chance to put the target to sleep. Deals 2× to a sleeping target.

steel_rare.name: Meteor Mash
steel_rare.desc: 50% chance of +1 Attack to the user.

steel_legendary.name: Behemoth Blade
steel_legendary.desc: Deals 1.5× to a target with any stat boost. After swinging, the user takes half damage until its next move.

fairy_common.name: Draining Kiss
fairy_common.desc: Heals the user for three quarters of the damage dealt.

fairy_rare.name: Moonblast
fairy_rare.desc: 30% chance to lower the target’s Attack and Sp.Atk by 1.

fairy_legendary.name: Geomancy
fairy_legendary.desc: The first use each battle gathers power instead of hitting: +2 Attack, +2 Sp.Atk, +2 Sp.Def, +2 Speed. Every use after that hits.
